name: exact
description: Build, run and test apps with Exact (expo/exact): sets up and updates the upstream checkout on use, then follows its start-here guide.

interface.longDescription: Agent skill for Exact (github.com/expo/exact), the all-platform app framework where UI is written in Contract and data logic in TypeScript or Rust. Each time it is used, the skill clones or updates an Exact checkout only when upstream moved, runs its setup when needed, and sends you to the checkout's start-here guide. When you start a new app, it checks expo/exact-templates once for a whole-app template that fits and makes the app from it. Use it to scaffold apps and websites, run verify, and drive hosts with Exact's agent loop. Not affiliated with Expo. Exact is pre-1.0 and changes daily.
defaultPrompt: Set up Exact and build a todo list app verified on web.
Start a chat app from the Exact templates and pass its web tests.
Start an Exact website from the site pattern and pass its tests.
